_note: Neutral starting tokens for pbip-kit v0.2. A glass (dark, transparent cards) example is in examples/tokens-glass.json.

colors._note: From /theme (preset clean), mode light: generated by design/scripts/gen_tokens.py; every text and state pair is WCAG 2.1 AA (design/reviews/theme.md). Roles: primary (bands, with onDark text; primaryText as text), brand (marks; brandText as text), bad / badMark, good, second (warning as text), selected + onSelected. teal*/red*/slate*/accent/neutral follow their roles so layouts written for the clean palette re-skin unchanged.

polarity._note: Which way is an improvement, per base measure: up = higher is better, down = lower is better, neutral = no good/bad colour. /plan fills it from brd.md section 4.

chart._note: Series order for the theme's dataColors, as names from colors.

fontPt._note: Power BI sizes in points: font px x 0.75, halves round up; caption raised from 9 to 10 for legibility (Rep 1).

pbiShadow._note: Power BI draws the CSS shadow darker (Rep 3), so visuals use this lighter mapping; preset Custom on every shadow.

container._note: Cards with a title and subtitle use paddingTop 14 (sides and bottom 20), so the title sits higher and the chart gets the space.

control._note: Slicers and buttons (px), pill-shaped (radius = half height). Button slicers under ~40px need padding.default Custom 0 top/bottom (CLAUDE.md). Dropdowns with a header need 76px (known-gaps). Selected tiles (button slicers, buttons, page navigators): fill colors.selected, which pbik build applies to every selected state a template brings, with the state text in colors.onSelected if set, else white or primary (whichever contrasts more) (#037C84, teal 12% darker, 4.98:1 with white text; teal itself is 4.0:1 and fails WCAG AA), e.g. props "fillCustom.fillColor@{\"id\": \"selection:selected\"}": "selected".

tags._note: Wireframe tags (press T): native / svg / html; text 4.5:1 on its fill.

a11y._note: pbik validate accessibility checks (CLAUDE.md Accessibility): the smallest text size allowed, in points.

theme._note: How these tokens were made (gen_tokens.py). recolourTemplates: pbik build maps the templates' clean colours to these names (design/templates/palette.json).
